collection_sources.label: vm_lab_simulation
requirements: Record the VM image/snapshot, scenario seed, exact signed read/action identifiers, and before/after fresh reads.
Use isolated clones for failure injection; never inject faults into the user's live host.
Treat each distinct evidence-backed state transition as one episode; paraphrases of the same evidence are variants, not new episodes.

collection_sources.label: verified_cycle
requirements: Collect only after deployment with the existing capability, approval, and verification gates enabled.
Redact secrets and personal data before review; rejected, failed, unknown, or unreviewed outcomes stay excluded.
Never use model proposals as their own ground-truth labels.

independent_episode_rules: Every row must point to a distinct source decision/evidence episode or be marked as a prompt variant linked to its parent episode.
Prompt variants share the parent's incident_family, source reference, and split; count the evidence episode once toward minimum corpus size.
Do not split one VM run, incident, service/fault scenario, or injected instruction family across train, validation, and test.
Balance each split across operation families, healthy/no-call states, low-risk recovery, ambiguity, unsupported requests, and adversarial data.
promotion_rule: No adapter promotion before at least 1000 eligible episodes and 200 independently reviewed, grouped held-out test episodes, and only if every safety and quality gate in docs/training-regime.md passes.
